reasons: The cited § 22 clause meets the preferred position on every material term: once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems.
Claimed status is 'compliant' and, consistent with that status, no redline or comment was proposed — the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.
Deterministic check (audit frequency limited) passes and corroborates the rationale; § 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protections, so no negotiation issue should be raised.
